brief:
An Israeli sniper shot and killed a Palestinian mother hours after she saw her husband and daughter off to Egypt for medical treatment, Middle East Eye reported. The family had been leaving Gaza when the woman was struck on her way home.

The killing occurred as the family attempted to access medical care outside Gaza. Details of the circumstances surrounding the incident remain limited.

title: Israeli sniper kills Palestinian mother in Gaza
